summary: Frontend-only testing of the Swiss Brutalist portfolio site recreation. Validated page load, navigation links, hero section + CTAs, contact form (frontend-only), experience collapsible rows, personal details, mobile menu, and back-to-top. All targeted data-testid elements present and functional. No console/page errors. Contact form submission is intentionally frontend-only (sonner toast) — verified empty-state and success-state toasts both fire, and the form is cleared after success.
